motivation.zh: 把平方根素数步长的覆盖定位到每个长度约 X^(3/4) 的子窗。两矩合用可在每窗得到正比例富终点；漏点密度趋零仍需下尾估计。
motivation.en: Localize square-root prime steps to every block of length about X^(3/4). Together the moments give positive rich-target density in each block; vanishing miss density still needs lower-tail control.

tasks.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let W := fun X : ℕ => Nat.sqrt X * Nat.sqrt (Nat.sqrt X); let B := fun (X y : ℕ) => (E X).filter (fun n => y ≤ n ∧ n < y + W X); let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W X ≤ 2*X → c*(W X:ℝ)*M X ≤ ∑ n ∈ B X y, (H X n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 每个四分之三次幂短窗中的素数路径总量下界
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound prime arrivals in every three-quarter-power block

brief.zh: 把大素数限制在短窗中段，使每个允许的小素数与其相加仍在窗内。关键是对所有起点一致的短区间素数计数下界；全区间的一阶矩不能直接限制到子窗。 可按任务 imports 引用已证引理。
brief.en: Place the large prime inside the middle of the block so every allowed small step stays inside. Establish a short-interval prime lower bound uniform in the block origin; global mass alone gives no local lower bound. Verified lemmas are available through task imports.

tasks.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let W := fun X : ℕ => Nat.sqrt X * Nat.sqrt (Nat.sqrt X); let B := fun (X y : ℕ) => (E X).filter (fun n => y ≤ n ∧ n < y + W X); let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W X ≤ 2*X → (∑ n ∈ B X y, (H X n:ℝ)^2) ≤ C*(W X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 每个四分之三次幂短窗中的共同终点碰撞预算
plain_statement.en: Bound common-endpoint collisions in every three-quarter-power block

brief.zh: 展开平方并分开对角项。把两个平移素数的筛估计限制在长度 W 的移动区间，控制与起点无关的余项，再平均位移奇异因子。直接限制已证全区间上界会损失 X/W。 可按任务 imports 引用已证引理。
brief.en: Separate diagonal and off-diagonal pairs. Localize the shifted-prime sieve to length W with a remainder uniform in the origin, then average the shift factors. Restricting the global bound loses X/W. Verified lemmas are available through task imports.
